purpose: The site footer: brand mark, four link lists, two legal lines and the interactive dot field. Present on 4 of the 6 routes; the 404 does not render it, which is why #dotsField is absent there.

linkLists.note: Exactly 4 lists: left-primary (PDP's, Videos), left-secondary (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy), right-primary (Products, Our features), right-secondary (Instagram, Facebook, Youtube - the last two .is-hide).

legalLine.note: Measured: 8 words, "(c) <year>, Fourmula ltd. UK, London. All rights reserved." with the year injected by public/motion/m03.js from [data-current-year].

registrationLine.note: Measured: 7 words, "Registered in England & Wales No.: 13044361".

dotsField.note: Exactly 14 rows always; 52 / 24 / 22 columns at m07.js's own JS thresholds, so 728 / 336 / 308 dots.

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.

constraints.verification: src/layout/Layout.jsx:44 renders it behind a `footer` flag that defaults to true; src/pages/NotFound.jsx:7 passes footer={false}. Checked against all 5 real templates: present once and immediately before chrome.awards-badge in home / legal / app-onboarding / app-auth, and ABSENT from not-found.

motion.detail: public/motion/m15.js reveals .footer over 0.2s power2.out. m07.js builds the dot grid and rebuilds it on resize; m08.js runs an idle wave outward from the grid centre using steps(2); m09.js adds a cursor-proximity opacity response at 0.2s power2.out. Every dot rests at opacity 0.15.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Render the footer and the full dot grid statically at the dots' resting opacity of 0.15, with no idle wave and no cursor response.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.max-991px: from 768px up m07.js rebuilds at 24 x 14 = 336 dots; the CSS keeps the 1rem dot size
responsive.max-767px: m07.js rebuilds at 22 x 14 = 308 dots and the CSS drops the dot size and gap to 0.5rem

measuredFrom.quote: Fourmula ltd. UK, London. All rights reserved.

notes: The real markup also carries 21 empty <div className="js-global w-embed w-script"> placeholders where the original's inline scripts used to sit; those scripts now live as the 26 files in public/motion/ loaded by src/loadSite.js. The placeholders are kept so the DOM matches the original.
contentMaxWordsTotalNote: Set BETWEEN the measured real total and the maximum the per-field budgets allow, so the cap can actually reject an over-long instance instead of being unreachable. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] fails if any declared contentMaxWordsTotal becomes vacuous (>= the per-field maximum).
